notes.title: v2.0 Update Status
notes.notes:
I wanted to give everyone the status on the v2.0 update of Demonstar. A lot of work went into getting what is currently there. Very soon I'll have the full release of v2.0 ready to go. The game has improvements in almost every category of the game; from the levels, level backdrop graphics, to enemies, even the loading screen. The entire game has a fresh coat of paint that will be worth taking your wings and soaring back into Demonstar.

For those of you that didn't know I've been dealing with my moms health issues for over a year and it slowed development down a lot. After all this time I just wanted to make sure this update is perfect for all all the fans who have been waiting for it.

PEACE
Scott Host
